create.name: Tama Kieves
create.bio:
Tama Kieves graduated with honours from Harvard Law School and worked as a corporate lawyer before leaving the profession to write and to help others find work that matters to them. Her first book, This Time I Dance!, told the story of that change, and it was followed by Inspired & Unstoppable, A Year Without Fear, Thriving Through Uncertainty and, in 2025, Learning to Trust Yourself. A student of A Course in Miracles for more than three decades, she draws on its teaching that fear can give way to love and inner guidance, and presents it in a practical, conversational way rather than as doctrine.

Working from Denver, Colorado, she coaches people one to one on career change, creative projects and book writing, and runs an online membership group, the Inspired & Unstoppable Life Tribe, which meets live on Zoom. She also leads seasonal online programmes such as A Month of Miracles, along with residential weekends including Unleash Your Calling at Kripalu and a retreat at the Sivananda Ashram in the Bahamas. Her sessions mix candid personal stories, humour and simple exercises meant to help people trust their own judgement and act on what they most want to do with their lives.

books.title: Learning to Trust Yourself: Breaking Through the Blocks That Hold You Back
books.author: Tama Kieves
books.description: Tama Kieves's 2025 book on self-trust as the ground for confidence and a fulfilling life. Through personal stories and practical exercises, it looks at how people talk themselves out of their own instincts and how to start listening to them again.

books.title: This Time I Dance!: Creating the Work You Love
books.author: Tama Kieves
books.description: The story of how Kieves walked away from a corporate law career to write and build a living around work she cared about. It doubles as a guide for readers who want to make a similar change.

books.title: Inspired & Unstoppable: Wildly Succeeding in Your Life's Work!
books.author: Tama Kieves
books.description: A follow-up to her first book that mixes spirituality with practical advice on building meaningful work. Kieves describes how unconventional, intuitive choices helped her creative plans grow, and coaches readers to do the same.

books.title: A Year Without Fear: 365 Days of Magnificence
books.author: Tama Kieves
books.description: A daily reader of short reflections and five-minute shifts in outlook, one for each day of the year. Each entry encourages readers to move past fear and take a step towards the work and life they want.

books.title: Thriving Through Uncertainty: Moving Beyond Fear of the Unknown and Making Change Work for You
books.author: Tama Kieves
books.description: A practical guide to periods of change and transition. Kieves argues that not knowing what comes next can become a starting point, and offers ways to rely on inner guidance instead of doubt.

courses.title: Unleash Your Calling: Creating the Work and Life You Love
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, for people who sense a different kind of work or life calling them. Tama leads exercises and group coaching on choosing a direction, meeting fear and turning talents into a livelihood, drawing on her book Learning to Trust Yourself.

courses.title: Unleash Your Calling Retreat in the Bahamas
courses.description: The same calling-focused weekend held at the Sivananda Ashram Yoga Retreat on Paradise Island in the Bahamas. Coaching sessions run alongside the ashram's daily yoga and meditation schedule.

courses.title: Inspired Life and Career Coaching
courses.description: One-to-one sessions with Tama on career change, creative direction, business or book writing. She works without a fixed formula, starting from where the client is and looking for what already works for them.
courses.price: $425 USD per session, or 3 sessions for $1,195 USD

courses.title: The Inspired & Unstoppable Life Tribe
courses.description: An ongoing group coaching membership that meets live with Tama on Zoom, with recordings for those who cannot attend. Members work together on trusting their inner guidance and moving forward with their plans.
courses.price: $45 USD per month, or $99 USD every 3 months

courses.title: A Month of Miracles
courses.description: Four weekly evening sessions on Zoom through December, recorded for later viewing. Tama blends ideas from A Course in Miracles with her coaching to help participants end the year with more trust and less stress.

courses.title: Career and Calling Revolution
courses.description: A recorded evening class in which Tama shares her main strategies for finding and following meaningful work. It is aimed at anyone who feels there is more they are meant to be doing.

free_resources.title: 3 Free Days of Coaching Videos
free_resources.description: A short series of coaching videos sent over three days after signing up. Each one offers a tool or question for moving past fear and getting clear on the work and life you want.
